name: trim-burst
title: Trim Burst
description: Short strokes shoot outward from a point and shrink to nothing: a quick spark, pop or impact accent.
useWhen: A click, hit, pop or reveal needs a quick burst of lines as a punctuation accent.
A UI action or number landing should feel celebratory without a full particle system.
avoidWhen: You need a large, sustained celebration: use confetti or particles.
The burst should sit on a moving target: the origin is a fixed point.
author: Remocn

variables.label: X
variables.description: Burst origin across the frame, 0 (left) to 1 (right).

variables.label: Y
variables.description: Burst origin down the frame, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

variables.label: Inner radius
variables.description: Gap between the origin and where strokes start, at a 720 px frame height.

variables.label: Rotation
variables.description: Rotation of the whole burst in degrees.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Angle covered by the strokes; below 360 they fan out around the rotation.

variables.label: Jitter
variables.description: Random variety in angle, length and launch time.

variables.label: Tip dots
variables.description: Pop a small dot at the tip of each stroke.

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) before the burst starts.
